svg.title: JJ — work overview
svg.desc: A work graph with JJ, high-level StackAI themes, and four public projects, styled with dark panels, monospace labels, and green accents. Each segment in the activity orbit represents one week of publicly displayed GitHub contributions; brighter, thicker segments mean more activity. Connections represent shared interests.

g.text: AI products / agent systems / practical tools
Brighter orbit segments = more contributions that week.
